The plate is a square plate, roughly 26 cm across, so I used that as the ruler.

**Squash and zucchini:** The pile covers about 11 x 9 cm and is about 2 cm thick, with slices that are fairly thin. That is roughly 10 pieces, which I estimate at about 150 g. It is a mix of green zucchini and yellow squash, cooked and without visible oil, so I used 25 kcal per 100 g.

**Pizza slice:** This looks like a thin rectangular cheese pizza piece, about 10 x 8 cm and 1.5 cm thick. That is about 80 cm³ at a density of roughly 0.6 g/cm³, so about 60 g. Cheese pizza runs about 270 kcal per 100 g.
